claim: For symmetric encryption multi-Region keys with AWS_KMS origin, you enable and disable automatic rotation, and initiate on-demand rotation, only on the primary key; KMS creates new key material for the primary key and copies the new key material across Region boundaries to all related replica keys.

qualifiers.scope: symmetric encryption multi-Region keys with AWS_KMS origin

evidence.quote: You enable and disable automatic key rotation only on the primary key. You initiate on-demand rotation only on the primary key.
When AWS KMS rotates the key material, it creates new key material for the primary key and then copies the new key material across Region boundaries to all related replica keys.
You can enable and disable automatic rotation and perform on-demand rotation of the key material in symmetric encryption multi-Region keys with AWS_KMS origin.
